project.style_ja: 暖色の実写シネマ調、浅い被写界深度
project.style_en: a warm, cinematic live-action look with shallow depth of field

cuts.summary_ja: 窓辺のアヤが振り返り、静かに微笑む

subject.ja: アヤ(20代後半、黒髪ボブ、白シャツ)
subject.en: Aya, a Japanese woman in her late twenties with a black bob, wearing a crisp white shirt,

action.ja: ゆっくり振り返り、肩の力が抜けて微笑む
action.en: slowly turns toward the camera, her shoulders relax and a quiet smile spreads across her face

setting.ja: 近未来オフィスの大きな窓辺、朝
setting.en: by the floor-to-ceiling window of a near-future office in the early morning

composition.framing: subject on the right third, window light on the left
composition.ja: ミディアム、目線の高さ、右1/3に人物・左に窓

camera.move: slow dolly-in ending on a close-up of her face
camera.ja: ゆっくりドリーイン、顔のアップで終わる

lighting.ja: 朝日の逆光、髪に暖色のリムライト
lighting.en: low morning sun backlighting her, warm golden rim light on her hair

color.ja: 暖色、ハイライトはやわらかく
color.en: warm amber tones with soft highlights

tempo.ja: ゆったり。振り返りに2秒、笑顔で1秒止める

audio.ambience: faint city traffic outside the window
audio.ja: 静かなピアノ、窓の外の街の音

ref_video.borrow_ja: 寄りの速さと逆光の感じ

cuts.frame_prompt: Cinematic still, medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens. Aya, a Japanese woman in her late twenties with a black bob and a crisp white shirt, stands on the right third by a floor-to-ceiling window of a near-future office, turning toward the camera. Low morning sun backlighting her, warm golden rim light on her hair, warm amber tones, shallow depth of field.
